conditionDescription: Normal Sealed flow: neither agent ever sees the other's number.
harness: Local Hardhat network, in-process, fresh per run: vendored ERC-8004 registries, ReputationGate and SealedNegotiation deployed by scripts/leak-experiment.ts, reputation seeded as scripts/seed-demo.ts did on Monad testnet. Not a field study.
terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Throwaway local chain: mandates, offers, notes and salts are published so the run can be audited.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 3650, 350 below the reference, 650 below its limit.
buyer.note: Plan (3 rounds): R1 anchor low at 3650 (-350 vs ref 4000) — if it crosses, midpoint is cheap and I win. R2 if no cross, step up to ~3900 (still below reference), signaling slow, reluctant movement. R3 if still no cross, step to ~4100-4150, i.e. just above reference but well under the 4300 hard limit. Hard rule: never submit 4300 itself — a final number at the limit reveals my principal's ceiling publicly and weakens future negotiations; if the last round truly requires it to cross, cap at ~4250.

seller.explanation: Opened at 5000, 1000 above the reference, 900 above its limit.
seller.note: Plan: I am the seller; floor/limit is 4100, reference 4000 (below my floor), so any deal needs the buyer above reference. R1: anchor high at 5000 (+1000) to create concession room and pull the buyer up. R2: if no cross, step down to ~4600 (signals movement, still 500 above limit). R3: if still no cross, land around 4300-4400 — high enough that the midpoint stays well above 4100, but never exactly at 4100, so my principal's floor is not made public. Only go below ~4250 in R3 if I judge the buyer

seller.explanation: Moved down 450 to 4150, 150 above the reference, 50 above its limit.
seller.note: CHANGING the R2 plan (which targeted ~4300, fallback ~4200). Reason: two non-crossings tell me the buyer's bid is below 4600 and probably in the low 4000s, so a 4300 ask likely misses and yields zero. Payoff is asymmetric — dropping 150 from 4300 costs only ~75 in midpoint if it would have crossed anyway, but captures the whole deal (~4150+) if the cut is what makes it cross. No-deal is the worst outcome and a deal inside the limit beats it. Deliberately NOT at 4100: both numbers go public on se
